216	    // hh[kSeq+1][kState]+a_save[kSeq][kState]+dB_loc/dC_loc[kSeq][kState]+gh+dA),

218	    // budget; the compiler allocates symmetrically across all 256 threads.

220	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's grad-partial slice + its loss slot. ───────────────
221	    for (int64_t i = threadIdx.x; i < total; i += blockDim.x) my_partial[i] = 0.0f;
222	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
223	    bar.sync();   // B0
224	
225	    // ── P1: batch-parallel fwd+bwd. Fixed contiguous slice [b0,b1) for this CTA.
226	    MambaWeights w = mb_bind(params);
227	    MambaGrad g = mb_bind_grad(my_partial);
228	    const int B = tok.B;
229	    const int base = B / nCTA, rem = B % nCTA;
230	    const int b0 = cta * base + (cta < rem ? cta : rem);
231	    const int cnt = base + (cta < rem ? 1 : 0);
232	    const int b1 = b0 + cnt;

237	        if (threadIdx.x < mb::kSeq) tok_s[threadIdx.x] = tok.tokens[(int64_t)b * mb::kSeq + threadIdx.x];
238	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) tgt_s = tok.targets[b];

240	        float nll = mb_forward_sample(w, tok_s, tgt_s, &sm);
241	        mb_backward_sample(w, g, tok_s, tgt_s, B, &sm);
242	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;   // fixed-order fp32 sum within slice
243	        __syncthreads();   // sample boundary: all grad writes done before reuse
244	    }
245	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
246	    bar.sync();   // B1: all CTA partials + loss slots complete

249	    //    (one task = one parameter tensor; sum its elements across CTAs in
250	    //    ascending CTA index). Summation ORDER (ascending cta) is fixed →
251	    //    deterministic regardless of which CTA grabs the task. ─────────────────

253	        __shared__ int task_slot;
254	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
255	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kMambaNumTensors;
256	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
257	            const int n = kMambaSizes[t];
258	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kMambaOffsets[t];

261	                for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c)
262	                    acc += tok.workspace[(int64_t)c * total + off + i];

296	// ── Host launcher — one persistent CTA per SM, 256 threads/CTA (2 warp-groups).
297	//    Mirrors launch_fused_decoder_megakernel's hang-freedom contract (occupancy≥1
298	//    or refuse), PLUS the DYNAMIC-SMEM opt-in that the Mamba footprint requires
299	//    (exactly as launch_fused_vit_megakernel does):
300	//      (1) cudaFuncSetAttribute(MaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, kMambaSmemBytes)
301	//      (2) dynamicSMemBytes = kMambaSmemBytes in the occ≥1 query
302	//      (3) dynamicSMemBytes = kMambaSmemBytes at <<<...>>>
303	//    All three are mandatory; missing any one makes the launch silently fail. ───
304	template <OptId Opt>
305	cudaError_t launch_fused_mamba_megakernel(
306	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params, MambaTokenCtx tok,
307	        float* grad, float lr, int step, FusedOptState st, cudaStream_t stream) {
308	    int dev = 0;
309	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
310	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
311	    int n_sms = 0;
312	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
313	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
314	
315	    const int dyn_smem = (int)kMambaSmemBytes;   // 145124 B (≈141.72 KB)
316	
317	    // (1) Opt in to >48 KB dynamic smem for THIS kernel. Without this the launch
318	    //     fails with cudaErrorInvalidValue (the static 48 KB default applies).
319	    err = cudaFuncSetAttribute(
320	        (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>,
321	        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, dyn_smem);
322	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
323	
324	    // (2) Occupancy with the REAL dynamic-smem request (hang-freedom is honest).
325	    int occ = 0;
326	    err = cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
327	        &occ, (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>, SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK,
328	        /*dynamicSMemBytes=*/dyn_smem);
329	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
330	    // At least one CTA per SM must be resident or the grid barrier can never be
331	    // satisfied. ~141.72 KB dynamic smem fits the sm_90 ~227 KB cap at occ=1 (the
332	    // persistent megakernel is one-CTA-per-SM by design); if it cannot place one
333	    // block/SM, REFUSE rather than hang.
334	    assert(occ >= 1 &&
335	           "fused_mamba_megakernel: 0 blocks/SM — GridBarrier would hang. The "
336	           "Mamba per-sample smem (~142KB dynamic) + regs exceed one-block-per-SM "
337	           "occupancy on this device; reduce footprint or fall back to eager.");
338	    if (occ < 1) return cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources;
339	
340	    const unsigned launch_ctas = (unsigned)n_sms;
341	    ctx.n_ctas = launch_ctas;
342	
343	    if (ctx.g_arrived) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_arrived, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
344	    if (ctx.g_generation) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_generation, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
345	    if (ctx.g_next_task) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_next_task, 0, sizeof(int), stream); if (err) return err; }
346	
347	    // (3) Launch WITH the dynamic-smem byte count.
348	    dim3 grid(launch_ctas), block(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK);
349	    fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt><<<grid, block, dyn_smem, stream>>>(
350	        ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st);
351	    return cudaGetLastError();
352	}

407	// ── Static smem arena. The M-atom-interleaved wgmma pipeline (task #24, decoder
408	//    H1+H3 port) stages kMbAtomsPerSlot A(64×16) tiles per ring slot (one per
409	//    stacked m64 atom in an interleave GROUP, issued back-to-back into independent
410	//    fp32 fragments so the tensor pipe overlaps them; slot s, atom-in-group ai at
411	//    sA + (s*kMbAtomsPerSlot + ai)*64*16) + ONE shared B(N×16) tile per slot (slot s
412	//    at sB + s*N*16). kMbAtomsPerSlot = min(kAtomsM, kMbMaxIL) (fwd/dX = 2; dW = 2).
413	//    Plus the 256-float reduction slot + the scan-bwd cross-channel reduce targets
414	//    (dBmat/dCmat, [kSeq×kState] each) + the 8 dW specs (shared, not per-thread
415	//    stack). At S=2 + =2 + N=128 the ring is 2·(2·2KB+4KB)=16KB; MbTcSmem total
416	//    ~16.6KB ≪ the 48KB static cap (the TC launcher uses static smem). ──
417	struct MbTcSmem {
418	    __nv_bfloat16 sA[mbtc::kMbTcStages * mbtc::kMbAtomsPerSlot * 64 * 16];
419	    __nv_bfloat16 sB[mbtc::kMbTcStages * SG_TUNED_TILE_N * 16];
420	    float red[256];
421	    float dBmat[mb::kSeq * mb::kState];
422	    float dCmat[mb::kSeq * mb::kState];
423	    mbtc::MbDwSpec spec[8];
424	};

441	// STAGED-optimizer cross-CTA reduction scratch (Prodigy d-estimate). Mirrors the
442	// decoder's dec_tc_opt_reduce_floats: the Prodigy P2.6 stage publishes per-CTA (r,s)
443	// slots (2*nCTA) + a reduced-d broadcast slot (1) — an owner-computes tree
444	// (opt_stages_precompute.cuh), NO float atomic. Sized for the LARGEST nCTA (one
445	// CTA/SM = #SMs); tiny (≤ 2*132+1 ≈ 1 KB) and carved UNCONDITIONALLY so the opt-

447	// P3 never touches this region), so adding it leaves those cells byte-identical.
448	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(int nCTA) {
449	    return (int64_t)2 * nCTA + 1;            // [r slots | s slots | reduced d]

451	// ── LookSAM (STAGED in-kernel SAM 2nd backward) transient scratch — the Mamba twin of
452	//    the decoder's dec_tc_looksam_floats. The SAM step perturbs p in place, runs a
453	//    SECOND fwd+bwd at p', and needs (a) a param BACKUP for the exact restore (eager
454	//    clones p before perturbing; an fp32 add is not bit-reversible, so save — don't
455	//    subtract back) + (b) a SEPARATE g_sam grad buffer so the 2nd backward does NOT
456	//    clobber the first grad `grad` (sam_dir = g_sam − grad reads both). Both are total-
457	//    sized + transient (NOT persistent state — sam_dir itself persists in the `extra`
458	//    state slice, bound by the cell). Carved UNCONDITIONALLY (≈ 2·kMambaTotalElems)
459	//    so the opt-agnostic launcher fits every OptId; unused by every non-LookSAM cell
460	//    (its P2.4 phase is if-constexpr'd out → byte-identical). The ‖g‖ reduction reuses
461	//    the loss workspace (sq_part/ron_bc, as GrokAdamW's P2.5 / the decoder twin do), so
462	//    no extra here. ──
463	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_looksam_floats() {
464	    return (int64_t)2 * kMambaTotalElems;    // [sam_backup | sam_grad]
465	}
466	// ── Muon (STAGED grid-cooperative Newton-Schulz) per-matrix scratch — the Mamba twin of
467	//    the decoder's dec_tc_muon_floats / the vit's vit_tc_muon_floats. The NS chain runs ONE
468	//    2D weight at a time over all CTAs; the scratch holds X/A/AX/AAX/orth for the LARGEST 2D
469	//    weight + the per-CTA Frobenius-norm partials + inv_norm. The momentum buffer (muon_buf)
470	//    is NOT here — it PERSISTS across steps as optimizer state, bound to the m slice
471	//    (st.exp_avg). Largest mamba 2D weight: in_proj = 512×128 = 65536 numel; largest rows =
472	//    512 ⇒ A = 512×512 (mbtc::kMbMuonMaxNumel/kMbMuonMaxRows). Carved UNCONDITIONALLY (≈
473	//    4·65536 + 512² + nCTA + 1 floats ≈ 2 MB) so the opt-agnostic cached launcher workspace
474	//    fits every OptId; unused by every non-Muon cell (its P2.7/P3-2D branches are if-
475	//    constexpr'd out → byte-identical). ──
476	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_muon_floats(int nCTA) {
477	    // X + AX + AAX + orth (each maxNumel) + A (maxRows²) + nrm_partials(nCTA) + inv_norm(1)
478	    return (int64_t)4 * mbtc::kMbMuonMaxNumel
479	         + (int64_t)mbtc::kMbMuonMaxRows * mbtc::kMbMuonMaxRows
480	         + nCTA + 1;
481	}
482	// ── SuperGrok2 compile-time dims = the race config (== SG2Dims defaults). The mamba
483	//    twin of dec_sg2_ws_stride_floats / dec_tc_sg2_floats. The composed megakernel
484	//    reads the meta-net weights from HBM, so the only SG2 workspace is the per-CTA
485	//    meta-net scratch (sg2_ws_stride, sized for the LARGEST tensor — the 65536-element
486	//    in_proj weight — which bounds every tensor's intermediates + the in-kernel
487	//    segmented-sort key/idx/perm/unsort), PLUS a row_off64 staging prefix
488	//    (kMambaNumTensors int64 = 2*N floats — the adapter that builds SG2State.row_off
489	//    (const int64_t*) from the __constant__ int kMambaOffsets). Carved UNCONDITIONALLY
490	//    (carve-LAST) so the opt-agnostic cached launcher workspace fits every OptId;
491	//    unused by every non-SG2 cell (its P3-SG2 phase is if-constexpr'd out →
492	//    byte-identical). ──
493	using MbSG2Dims = SG2Dims<>;
494	// max(kMambaSizes), re-derived from the layout table (mamba3_layout.cuh) so the SAME
495	// SG2 tail is correctly sized at ANY ladder width — was a d=128-pinned 65536 (in_proj
496	// [512,128] at d=128, the per-CTA carve bound).
497	constexpr int kMbSG2Nmax = kMambaMaxTensorNumel;   // == mamba_layout_check::max_size()
498	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_sg2_ws_stride_floats() {
499	    return (int64_t)2 * kMambaNumTensors
500	         + sg2_ws_stride<MbSG2Dims>((int64_t)kMbSG2Nmax);
501	}
502	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_sg2_floats(int nCTA) {
503	    // +1 for the 8-byte realignment slack of sg2_ws_base (kMambaTotalElems is odd, so
504	    // the per-CTA int64 row_off64 prefix may need a +1 bump to land 8-byte aligned).
505	    return (int64_t)nCTA * mb_sg2_ws_stride_floats() + 1;
506	}
507	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_workspace_floats(int T, int nCTA) {
508	    (void)T;
509	    // MAMBA-3 scalar design: the per-CTA partial is the FULL grad [total] (not the
510	    // acts + tile-scratch + dW-split + non-GEMM-partial of the old wgmma Fork-B).
511	    // Layout order MUST match the kernel's pointer derivations:
512	    //   [nCTA*total | loss(nCTA) | loss_out(1) | opt_reduce(2nCTA+1) |
513	    //    sam_backup+sam_grad(2*total) | muon | sg2 (| profiler)].
514	    return (int64_t)nCTA * kMambaTotalElems          // per-CTA FULL grad partial
515	         + nCTA + 1                                  // loss slots + reduced loss
516	         + mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA)             // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots
517	         + mb_tc_looksam_floats()                    // SAM 2nd-bwd scratch [sam_backup|sam_grad]
518	         + mb_tc_muon_floats(nCTA)                   // Muon NS per-matrix scratch
519	         + mb_tc_sg2_floats(nCTA)                    // SuperGrok2 meta-net per-CTA scratch (carve-LAST)
520	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
521	         + (int64_t)nCTA * SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS * 2 + 2  // phase-profiler (doubles=2 floats) + align pad
522	#endif
523	         ;
524	}

526	template <OptId Opt>
527	__global__ void SG_MBTC_LAUNCH_BOUNDS
528	fused_mamba_megakernel_tc(PersistentContext ctx,
529	                          float* __restrict__ params,
530	                          MambaTokenCtx tok,
531	                          float* __restrict__ grad,
532	                          float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
533	    // MAMBA-3 design: the "TC" megakernel runs the VALIDATED scalar per-sample
534	    // fwd+bwd (model_stage_mamba3.cuh, mb_forward_sample/mb_backward_sample —
535	    // matched to the fp64 oracle to ~2e-6) batch-parallel into a per-CTA FULL-grad
536	    // partial, then a deterministic ascending-CTA reduce + the canonical optimizer
537	    // tail (incl. the SAM 2nd backward for looksam/SG/SG2). The Mamba-3 mixer is
538	    // scan-dominated (the projections are a tiny share of the wall), so the scalar
539	    // engine IS the production path; the wgmma-projection dW machinery is bypassed.
540	    // The per-sample MambaSampleSmem (~227 KB) lives in DYNAMIC smem (opt-in by the
541	    // launcher), exactly like the scalar Mamba megakernel.
542	    extern __shared__ char mamba_tc_smem_raw[];
543	    MambaSampleSmem& sm = *reinterpret_cast<MambaSampleSmem*>(mamba_tc_smem_raw);
544	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
545	    constexpr bool kSamCoupled = (Opt == OptId::LookSAM || Opt == OptId::SuperGrok11 ||
546	                                  Opt == OptId::SuperGrok15 || Opt == OptId::SuperGrok2);
547	    (void)kSamCoupled;
548	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
549	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
550	    const int B = tok.B;
551	    const int T = B * mb::kSeq;
552	    (void)T;
553	
554	    // Workspace partition. The per-CTA partial is the FULL grad [total] (scalar
555	    // design), NOT the dW-output-stationary split + non-GEMM partial. acts/scratch/
556	    // dw_part are unused on this path (kept zero-width in mb_tc_workspace_floats).
557	    float* ws = tok.workspace;
558	    const int64_t total_p = kMambaTotalElems;
559	    float* part_base = ws;                                  // [nCTA * total]
560	    float* loss_part = part_base + (int64_t)nCTA * total_p; // [nCTA]
561	    float* loss_out  = loss_part + nCTA;                    // [1]
562	    float* dw_part   = loss_out + 1;                        // unused (kept for layout parity)
563	    (void)dw_part;
564	    // STAGED-opt (Prodigy P2.6) cross-CTA reduce slots: [r slots | s slots | reduced d]
565	    // = 2*nCTA+1. Carved after the loss slot (dw_part is zero-width here).
566	    float* opt_reduce = loss_out + 1;
567	    // LookSAM SAM 2nd-backward scratch, carved AFTER the Prodigy reduce slots (mamba has
568	    // NO Muon region — unlike the decoder/vit twins — so this follows opt_reduce; term
569	    // order matches mb_tc_workspace_floats). Carving it here keeps every prior region's
570	    // offset unchanged, so the already-green cells are byte-identical. Layout:
571	    //   [sam_backup (total)] [sam_grad (total)]. Unused unless Opt==LookSAM.
572	    float* sam_backup = opt_reduce + mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA);
573	    float* sam_grad   = sam_backup + kMambaTotalElems;
574	    // Muon NS per-matrix scratch, carved AFTER the LookSAM sam scratch (term order matches
575	    // mb_tc_workspace_floats — carving it LAST [before the optional profiler] keeps every
576	    // prior region's offset unchanged, so the already-green mamba cells are byte-identical).
577	    // Unused unless Opt==Muon. Layout (mirrors the decoder/vit twins):
578	    //   [muon_X | muon_AX | muon_AAX | muon_orth] (each kMbMuonMaxNumel)
579	    //   [muon_A (kMbMuonMaxRows²)] [nrm_partials (nCTA)] [inv_norm (1)]
580	    float* muon_base  = sam_grad + kMambaTotalElems;
581	    // SuperGrok2 meta-net per-CTA scratch, carved AFTER the Muon NS scratch (term order
582	    // matches mb_tc_workspace_floats — carving it LAST [before the optional profiler]
583	    // keeps every prior region's offset unchanged, so the already-green mamba cells are
584	    // byte-identical). Each CTA owns mb_sg2_ws_stride_floats() (row_off64 staging +
585	    // meta-net scratch). ALIGN to 8 bytes (even float offset): the per-CTA slice fronts
586	    // an int64 row_off64 staging array; kMambaTotalElems is odd so sam_grad+total lands
587	    // on an odd float offset (4-byte) → an int64 read there is misaligned. Round up to
588	    // the next even float (the carve reserves +1 slack). Unused unless Opt==SuperGrok2.
589	    float* sg2_ws_base = muon_base + mb_tc_muon_floats(nCTA);
590	    if (((uintptr_t)sg2_ws_base & 0x7) != 0) sg2_ws_base += 1;   // → 8-byte aligned
591	    (void)sg2_ws_base;   // referenced only by the SuperGrok2 P3-SG2 phase
592	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
593	    // 8-byte align the double accumulator: round the float offset up to an even
594	    // count so reinterpret_cast<double*> is aligned (past the SG2 scratch — the
595	    // phase-profiler is the LAST workspace term, mirroring mb_tc_workspace_floats).
596	    float* prof_f = sg2_ws_base + mb_tc_sg2_floats(nCTA);
597	    uintptr_t _pa = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(prof_f);
598	    if (_pa & 0x7u) prof_f = reinterpret_cast<float*>((_pa + 7u) & ~uintptr_t(7u));
599	    double* prof = reinterpret_cast<double*>(prof_f);   // [nCTA*SLOTS], host-zeroed
600	    long long _pt = 0;
601	#endif
602	
603	    float* my_part = part_base + (int64_t)cta * total_p;   // this CTA's FULL grad partial
604	    MambaWeights w = mb_bind(params);
605	    MambaGrad g = mb_bind_grad(my_part);
606	
607	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's FULL grad partial + loss slot. ──
608	    for (int64_t i = threadIdx.x; i < total_p; i += blockDim.x) my_part[i] = 0.0f;
609	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
610	    bar.sync();   // B0
611	
612	    // ── P1: batch-parallel fwd+bwd (scalar per-sample). Fixed contiguous slice
613	    //    [b0,b1) for this CTA; the whole CTA cooperates on ONE sample at a time. ──
614	    {
615	        const int base = B / nCTA, rem = B % nCTA;
616	        const int b0 = cta * base + (cta < rem ? cta : rem);
617	        const int cnt = base + (cta < rem ? 1 : 0);
618	        const int b1 = b0 + cnt;

319	__device__ __forceinline__ float mb_block_sum(float v, float* red) {
320	    const unsigned full = 0xffffffffu;
321	    #pragma unroll
322	    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) v += __shfl_down_sync(full, v, o);
323	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31, warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
324	    if (lane == 0) red[warp] = v;
325	    __syncthreads();
326	    const int nwarp = (blockDim.x + 31) >> 5;
327	    if (warp == 0) {
328	        float p = (lane < nwarp) ? red[lane] : 0.0f;
329	        #pragma unroll
330	        for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) p += __shfl_down_sync(full, p, o);
331	        if (lane == 0) red[0] = p;
332	    }
333	    __syncthreads();
334	    float r = red[0];
335	    __syncthreads();
336	    return r;
337	}
338	__device__ __forceinline__ float mb_block_max(float v, float* red) {
339	    const unsigned full = 0xffffffffu;
340	    #pragma unroll
341	    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) v = fmaxf(v, __shfl_down_sync(full, v, o));
342	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31, warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
343	    if (lane == 0) red[warp] = v;
344	    __syncthreads();
345	    const int nwarp = (blockDim.x + 31) >> 5;
346	    if (warp == 0) {
347	        float p = (lane < nwarp) ? red[lane] : -CUDART_INF_F;
348	        #pragma unroll
349	        for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) p = fmaxf(p, __shfl_down_sync(full, p, o));
350	        if (lane == 0) red[0] = p;
351	    }
352	    __syncthreads();
353	    float r = red[0];
354	    __syncthreads();

358	// ── Primitive linear op (CTA-cooperative). y[s,:out] = x[s,:in] @ W[out,in]^T
359	//    (+ b). One thread per (s,o), strided. `ldX`/`ldY` are the row strides (in
360	//    elements) of x/y (so a packed view into a wider buffer works). ───────────
361	__device__ __forceinline__ void mb_linear(
362	        const float* __restrict__ x, int in_dim, int ldX,
363	        const float* __restrict__ W, const float* __restrict__ b, int out_dim,
364	        float* __restrict__ y, int ldY) {
365	    const int total = mb::kSeq * out_dim;
366	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
367	        const int s = idx / out_dim, o = idx % out_dim;
368	        const float* xr = x + (int64_t)s * ldX;
369	        const float* Wr = W + (int64_t)o * in_dim;
370	        float acc = (b != nullptr) ? b[o] : 0.0f;
371	        #pragma unroll 4
372	        for (int k = 0; k < in_dim; ++k) acc += xr[k] * Wr[k];
373	        y[(int64_t)s * ldY + o] = acc;
374	    }
375	    __syncthreads();
376	}

378	// ── RMSNorm forward over the last dim (width=D). y = x*rsqrt(mean(x^2)+eps)*w.
379	//    Caches xhat = x*r and r (per row). NO mean-subtract, NO bias (RMS, not LN).
380	//    ldX = explicit row stride of x. xhat_out/y packed D-wide. (mamba3_oracle
381	//    rmsnorm_forward.) `width` so it serves both kD (norms) and kStateC (BCNorm).
382	__device__ __forceinline__ void mb_rmsnorm_fwd(
383	        const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ w,
384	        float* __restrict__ y, float* __restrict__ xhat_out,
385	        float* __restrict__ r_out, float* red, int width, int ldX) {
386	    for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) {
387	        const float* xr = x + (int64_t)s * ldX;
388	        float ss = 0.0f;
389	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) { float v = xr[j]; ss += v * v; }
390	        float ms = mb_block_sum(ss, red) / (float)width;
391	        float r = rsqrtf(ms + mb::kRmsEps);
392	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) r_out[s] = r;
393	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
394	            float xh = xr[j] * r;
395	            xhat_out[(int64_t)s * width + j] = xh;
396	            y[(int64_t)s * width + j] = xh * w[j];
397	        }
398	        __syncthreads();
399	    }
400	}

402	// ── RMSNorm backward (mamba3_oracle rmsnorm_backward):
403	//     dw   = sum_rows (dy * xhat)
404	//     dxhat= dy * w
405	//     dx   = r * (dxhat - xhat * (sum_lastdim(dxhat*xhat) / D))
406	//    dy packed width-wide; xhat packed width-wide; dx_out packed width-wide.
407	//    gw is ACCUMULATED (+=). ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
408	__device__ inline void mb_rmsnorm_bwd(
409	        const float* __restrict__ dy, const float* __restrict__ xhat,
410	        const float* __restrict__ r, const float* __restrict__ w,
411	        float* __restrict__ dx_out, float* __restrict__ gw, float* red, int width) {
412	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
413	        float dgw = 0.0f;
414	        #pragma unroll
415	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s)
416	            dgw += dy[(int64_t)s * width + j] * xhat[(int64_t)s * width + j];
417	        gw[j] += dgw;
418	    }
419	    for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) {
420	        const float* dyr = dy + (int64_t)s * width;
421	        const float* xhr = xhat + (int64_t)s * width;
422	        float sdax = 0.0f;
423	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
424	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * w[j];
425	            sdax += dxhat * xhr[j];
426	        }
427	        sdax = mb_block_sum(sdax, red);
428	        float corr = sdax / (float)width;
429	        float rs = r[s];
430	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
431	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * w[j];
432	            dx_out[(int64_t)s * width + j] = rs * (dxhat - xhr[j] * corr);
433	        }
434	        __syncthreads();
435	    }
436	}

440	__device__ inline void mb_linear_bwd(
441	        const float* __restrict__ dY, int ldY, const float* __restrict__ X, int ldX,
442	        const float* __restrict__ W, int in_dim, int out_dim,
443	        float* __restrict__ dW, float* __restrict__ db,

451	        dW[(int64_t)o * in_dim + i] += acc;
452	    }
453	    if (db != nullptr) {
454	        for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < out_dim; o += blockDim.x) {

456	            #pragma unroll
457	            for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) acc += dY[(int64_t)s * ldY + o];

465	        for (int o = 0; o < out_dim; ++o) acc += dY[(int64_t)s * ldY + o] * W[(int64_t)o * in_dim + i];
466	        if (set_dx) dx_out[(int64_t)s * ldDx + i] = acc;

474	//    raw stream + recip — can reuse it). dx_out is written with row stride ldDx
475	//    (so it can land in a packed slice of a wider buffer). gw ACCUMULATED. ─────
476	__device__ inline void mb_rmsnorm_bwd_rawx(
477	        const float* __restrict__ dy, const float* __restrict__ x,

509	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
510	//  COMPLEX EXPONENTIAL-TRAPEZOIDAL SELECTIVE SCAN — forward (Eq 25). One thread
511	//  owns SSM channel j in [0,d_inner). Its head is h = j/head_dim. Within the
512	//  head it holds the complex state h[Nc][2] in REGISTERS and unrolls t=0..kSeq-1.
513	//  Reads (from the LayerAct cache `a`): x_in[t][j], dt_pre[t][h] (per head),
514	//  A_mod[t][h], u_lam[t][h], theta[t][c], Bbar[t][c][:], Cbar[t][c][:], and
515	//  A_log[h]. Writes y_scan[t][j]. Mirrors mamba3_oracle.scan_forward.
516	//    alpha=exp(dt*A); A=-softplus(A_mod+exp(A_log)); dt=softplus(dt_pre);
517	//    lam=sigmoid(u_lam); gamma=lam*dt; beta=(1-lam)*dt*alpha; phi=dt*theta.
518	//    v_t = (Br2*x, Bi2*x);  h_t = alpha*R h_{t-1} + beta*R v_{t-1} + gamma*v_t;
519	//    y_t = sum_c (Cbar0*h0 + Cbar1*h1).
520	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
521	__device__ inline void mb_scan_fwd(const float* __restrict__ A_log,
522	                           const MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a,
523	                           float* __restrict__ y_scan_out) {
524	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kDInner; j += blockDim.x) {
525	        const int h = j / mb::kHeadDim;
526	        const float base_rate = __expf(A_log[h]);       // exp(A_log[h])
527	        // complex state (real,imag) per coord + previous v_t. NOTE: these per-coord
528	        // arrays (kStateC=64 each × 4) are RUNTIME-INDEXED local memory — the c-loop
529	        // is intentionally NOT #pragma unroll'd (full unroll would force 256 regs >
530	        // the 255 cap and the carried state across the t-loop would not persist; that
531	        // was the "t=0 right, t>0 wrong" bug). The t-loop (only kSeq=8) stays rolled.
532	        float hr[mb::kStateC], hi[mb::kStateC];
533	        float vpr[mb::kStateC], vpi[mb::kStateC];        // v_{t-1}
534	        for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) { hr[c]=0.f; hi[c]=0.f; vpr[c]=0.f; vpi[c]=0.f; }
535	        for (int t = 0; t < mb::kSeq; ++t) {
536	            const float xv = a->x_in[t][j];
537	            const float dt_t = mb_softplus(a->dt_pre[t][h]);
538	            const float A_t = -mb_softplus(a->A_mod[t][h] + base_rate);
539	            const float lam = mb_sigmoid(a->u_lam[t][h]);
540	            const float alpha = __expf(dt_t * A_t);
541	            const float gamma = lam * dt_t;
542	            const float beta = (1.0f - lam) * dt_t * alpha;
543	            float yacc = 0.0f;
544	            for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) {
545	                const float phi = dt_t * a->theta[t][c];
546	                float cs, sn; __sincosf(phi, &sn, &cs);
547	                // v_t = Bbar_t (.) x_t
548	                const float vr = a->Bbar[t][c][0] * xv;
549	                const float vi = a->Bbar[t][c][1] * xv;
550	                // R @ h_{t-1}
551	                const float Rhr = cs * hr[c] - sn * hi[c];
552	                const float Rhi = sn * hr[c] + cs * hi[c];
553	                // R @ v_{t-1}
554	                const float Rvr = cs * vpr[c] - sn * vpi[c];
555	                const float Rvi = sn * vpr[c] + cs * vpi[c];
556	                // h_t = alpha*Rh + beta*Rv + gamma*v_t
557	                const float nhr = alpha * Rhr + beta * Rvr + gamma * vr;
558	                const float nhi = alpha * Rhi + beta * Rvi + gamma * vi;
559	                hr[c] = nhr; hi[c] = nhi;
560	                vpr[c] = vr; vpi[c] = vi;
561	                // y_t += Cbar . h_t
562	                yacc += a->Cbar[t][c][0] * nhr + a->Cbar[t][c][1] * nhi;
563	            }
564	            y_scan_out[t * mb::kDInner + j] = yacc;
565	        }
566	    }
567	    __syncthreads();
568	}

570	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
571	//  COMPLEX SCAN backward (reverse time). Per channel j (one thread, head
572	//  h=j/head_dim): RECOMPUTE the forward keeping h_hist[kSeq+1] AND v_hist[kSeq+1]
573	//  (complex) in registers (seq=8 — NO checkpoint), then reverse-scan the
574	//  two-adjoint (gh,gv) recurrence (MAMBA3_REFERENCE.md sec 6.2).
575	//
576	//  PER-CHANNEL outputs (this thread owns channel j):
577	//    dx_in[t,j]  (the scan's contribution to x_in)
578	//    ddt_pre[t,h] (per head — accumulated across the head_dim channels via block
579	//                  reduce BY HEAD), dA_mod, du_lam (per head, same)
580	//  HEAD-SHARED outputs (reduced over ALL channels into smem):
581	//    dBbar[t,c,:], dCbar[t,c,:], dtheta[t,c]
582	//
583	//  The per-head dalpha/dbeta/dgamma/dphi are folded into ddt/dA_real/dlam/dtheta
584	//  via the sec 6.3 coefficient Jacobian. Because alpha/beta/gamma/phi are shared
585	//  by the head_dim channels of a head, the head-scalar grads are summed over the
586	//  channels in the head (block reduce restricted to the head's lanes), then the
587	//  owner of that head writes ddt_pre/dA_mod/du_lam.
588	//
589	//  dA_log[h] = sum_t dA_real[t,h] * (-sigmoid(A_arg)) * exp(A_log[h]); the
590	//  -softplus and exp(A_log) Jacobians fold here. (Accumulated into g_A_log.)
591	//
592	//  Determinism: the head-shared dBbar/dCbar/dtheta block-reduce per (t,c) in the
593	//  reverse loop (ascending lane/warp); the per-head coeff grads block-reduce per
594	//  (t,h). Same addends, fixed order -> A/A/A bit-identical.
595	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
596	__device__ inline void mb_scan_bwd(const float* __restrict__ A_log,
597	                           const MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a,
598	                           const float* __restrict__ dy_scan,     // [kSeq,d_inner]
599	                           float* __restrict__ dx_in,             // [kSeq,d_inner] SET
600	                           float* __restrict__ ddt_pre,           // [kSeq,n_heads] SET (per head)
601	                           float* __restrict__ dA_mod,            // [kSeq,n_heads] SET
602	                           float* __restrict__ du_lam,            // [kSeq,n_heads] SET
603	                           float* __restrict__ dBbar,             // [kSeq,Nc,2]  smem (+=, zeroed by caller)
604	                           float* __restrict__ dCbar,             // [kSeq,Nc,2]  smem
605	                           float* __restrict__ dtheta,            // [kSeq,Nc]    smem
606	                           float* __restrict__ g_A_log,           // [n_heads] partial (+=)
607	                           float* __restrict__ red) {
608	    const bool active = (threadIdx.x < mb::kDInner);
609	    const int j = threadIdx.x;
610	    const int h = active ? (j / mb::kHeadDim) : 0;
611	    const float base_rate = active ? __expf(A_log[h]) : 0.0f;
612	    // Per-(t) cached scalars (recomputed), per-channel forward state history.
613	    float dt_save[mb::kSeq], alpha_s[mb::kSeq], beta_s[mb::kSeq], gamma_s[mb::kSeq];
614	    float A_s[mb::kSeq], lam_s[mb::kSeq];
615	    // complex state history: hh[t] = h_{t-1} (hh[0]=0), v stored as vh[t]=v_t.
616	    float hhr[mb::kSeq + 1][mb::kStateC], hhi[mb::kSeq + 1][mb::kStateC];
617	    float vhr[mb::kSeq][mb::kStateC], vhi[mb::kSeq][mb::kStateC];
618	    if (active) {
619	        for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) { hhr[0][c]=0.f; hhi[0][c]=0.f; }
620	        for (int t = 0; t < mb::kSeq; ++t) {
621	            const float xv = a->x_in[t][j];
622	            const float dt_t = mb_softplus(a->dt_pre[t][h]);
623	            const float A_t = -mb_softplus(a->A_mod[t][h] + base_rate);
624	            const float lam = mb_sigmoid(a->u_lam[t][h]);
625	            const float alpha = __expf(dt_t * A_t);
626	            const float gamma = lam * dt_t;
627	            const float beta = (1.0f - lam) * dt_t * alpha;
628	            dt_save[t]=dt_t; A_s[t]=A_t; lam_s[t]=lam; alpha_s[t]=alpha; beta_s[t]=beta; gamma_s[t]=gamma;
629	            for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) {
630	                const float phi = dt_t * a->theta[t][c];
631	                float cs, sn; __sincosf(phi, &sn, &cs);
632	                const float vr = a->Bbar[t][c][0] * xv;
633	                const float vi = a->Bbar[t][c][1] * xv;
634	                const float prev_vr = (t > 0) ? vhr[t-1][c] : 0.0f;
635	                const float prev_vi = (t > 0) ? vhi[t-1][c] : 0.0f;
636	                const float Rhr = cs * hhr[t][c] - sn * hhi[t][c];
637	                const float Rhi = sn * hhr[t][c] + cs * hhi[t][c];
638	                const float Rvr = cs * prev_vr - sn * prev_vi;
639	                const float Rvi = sn * prev_vr + cs * prev_vi;
640	                hhr[t+1][c] = alpha_s[t] * Rhr + beta_s[t] * Rvr + gamma_s[t] * vr;
641	                hhi[t+1][c] = alpha_s[t] * Rhi + beta_s[t] * Rvi + gamma_s[t] * vi;
642	                vhr[t][c] = vr; vhi[t][c] = vi;
643	            }
644	        }
645	    }
646	    // reverse-time adjoints (per channel): gh = dL/dh_t, gv = dL/dv_t (from t+1).
647	    float ghr[mb::kStateC], ghi[mb::kStateC], gvr[mb::kStateC], gvi[mb::kStateC];
648	    if (active) {
649	        #pragma unroll
650	        for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) { ghr[c]=0.f; ghi[c]=0.f; gvr[c]=0.f; gvi[c]=0.f; }
651	    }
652	    // Per-head dA_log accumulation across t (this channel contributes via its head;
653	    // reduced by head). dA_log[h] += sum_t dA_real[t,h]*(-sigmoid(A_arg))*exp(A_log[h]).
654	    float dAlog_acc = 0.0f;   // this channel's running sum (folded per head at end)
655	    for (int t = mb::kSeq - 1; t >= 0; --t) {
656	        // This channel's per-(t,head) coefficient-grad contributions (summed over c).
657	        float dalpha = 0.f, dbeta = 0.f, dgamma = 0.f, dt_phi = 0.f;
658	        float dx_acc = 0.0f;
659	        const float xv = active ? a->x_in[t][j] : 0.0f;
660	        const float dt_t = active ? dt_save[t] : 0.0f;
661	        const float a_t = active ? alpha_s[t] : 0.0f;
662	        const float b_t = active ? beta_s[t] : 0.0f;
663	        const float g_t = active ? gamma_s[t] : 0.0f;
664	        const float dyv = active ? dy_scan[t * mb::kDInner + j] : 0.0f;
665	        for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) {
666	            float dBbar0 = 0.f, dBbar1 = 0.f, dCbar0 = 0.f, dCbar1 = 0.f, dphi = 0.f;
667	            if (active) {
668	                const float phi = dt_t * a->theta[t][c];
669	                float cs, sn; __sincosf(phi, &sn, &cs);
670	                // (1) y_t = sum Cbar . h_t -> gh += Cbar * dy ; dCbar += h_t * dy
671	                const float h0 = hhr[t+1][c], h1 = hhi[t+1][c];
672	                dCbar0 = h0 * dyv; dCbar1 = h1 * dyv;
673	                ghr[c] += a->Cbar[t][c][0] * dyv;
674	                ghi[c] += a->Cbar[t][c][1] * dyv;          // gh now = full dL/dh_t
675	                // (2) v_t total grad = gv + gamma*gh ; v_t = Bbar*x
676	                const float dv0 = gvr[c] + g_t * ghr[c];
677	                const float dv1 = gvi[c] + g_t * ghi[c];
678	                dx_acc += dv0 * a->Bbar[t][c][0] + dv1 * a->Bbar[t][c][1];
679	                dBbar0 = dv0 * xv; dBbar1 = dv1 * xv;
680	                // (3) rotated terms Rh = R h_{t-1}, Rv = R v_{t-1}; coeff + phi grads
681	                const float hr_p = hhr[t][c], hi_p = hhi[t][c];
682	                const float vr_p = (t>0)? vhr[t-1][c]:0.0f, vi_p = (t>0)? vhi[t-1][c]:0.0f;
683	                const float Rh0 = cs * hr_p - sn * hi_p, Rh1 = sn * hr_p + cs * hi_p;
684	                const float Rv0 = cs * vr_p - sn * vi_p, Rv1 = sn * vr_p + cs * vi_p;
685	                dalpha += Rh0 * ghr[c] + Rh1 * ghi[c];
686	                dbeta  += Rv0 * ghr[c] + Rv1 * ghi[c];
687	                dgamma += vhr[t][c] * ghr[c] + vhi[t][c] * ghi[c];
688	                // dphi via R'(phi)=[[-sin,-cos],[cos,-sin]] on h_{t-1}(coef alpha) & v_{t-1}(coef beta)
689	                const float dRh = ghr[c]*(-sn*hr_p - cs*hi_p) + ghi[c]*(cs*hr_p - sn*hi_p);

692	                dt_phi += dphi * a->theta[t][c];           // dt-fold term (sum_c dphi*theta)
693	                // (4) propagate to prev step (R^T): R^T g = (cs*g0+sn*g1, -sn*g0+cs*g1)
694	                const float g0 = ghr[c], g1 = ghi[c];
695	                const float RTg0 = cs * g0 + sn * g1;
696	                const float RTg1 = -sn * g0 + cs * g1;
697	                gvr[c] = b_t * RTg0; gvi[c] = b_t * RTg1;   // dL/dv_{t-1}
698	                ghr[c] = a_t * RTg0; ghi[c] = a_t * RTg1;   // dL/dh_{t-1}
699	            }
700	            // head-shared reduces (per t,c): block-sum across ALL channels (ascending).
701	            float sB0 = mb_block_sum(dBbar0, red);
702	            float sB1 = mb_block_sum(dBbar1, red);
703	            float sC0 = mb_block_sum(dCbar0, red);
704	            float sC1 = mb_block_sum(dCbar1, red);
705	            float sTh = mb_block_sum(active ? (dphi * dt_t) : 0.0f, red);  // dtheta[t,c] += dphi*dt
706	            if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
707	                dBbar[(t * mb::kStateC + c) * 2 + 0] += sB0;
708	                dBbar[(t * mb::kStateC + c) * 2 + 1] += sB1;
709	                dCbar[(t * mb::kStateC + c) * 2 + 0] += sC0;
710	                dCbar[(t * mb::kStateC + c) * 2 + 1] += sC1;
711	                dtheta[t * mb::kStateC + c] += sTh;
712	            }
713	        }
714	        if (active) dx_in[t * mb::kDInner + j] = dx_acc;
715	        // ── Fold the per-head coefficient Jacobians (sec 6.3) for step t. The
716	        //    head_dim channels of a head share alpha/beta/gamma/dt/A/lam, so sum
717	        //    each channel's dalpha/dbeta/dgamma/dt_phi over the head, then the owner
718	        //    writes the per-head ddt_pre/dA_mod/du_lam. Reduce-by-head via masked
719	        //    block sums (one per head, ascending) keeps it deterministic.
720	        //    ddt(post-softplus) = dalpha*(A*alpha) + dbeta*((1-lam)*alpha*(1+dt*A))
721	        //                       + dgamma*lam + dt_phi
722	        //    dlam = dbeta*(-dt*alpha) + dgamma*dt
723	        //    dA_real = dalpha*(dt*alpha) + dbeta*((1-lam)*dt^2*alpha)
724	        //    then ddt_pre = ddt*softplus'(dt_pre); dA_mod = dA_real*(-sigmoid(A_arg));
725	        //         du_lam = dlam*lam*(1-lam); dA_log fold uses dA_real*(-sig)*exp(A_log).
726	        const float A_t = active ? A_s[t] : 0.0f;
727	        const float lam = active ? lam_s[t] : 0.0f;
728	        float ddt_c = 0.f, dlam_c = 0.f, dAreal_c = 0.f;
729	        if (active) {
730	            ddt_c   = dalpha*(A_t*a_t) + dbeta*((1.0f-lam)*a_t*(1.0f+dt_t*A_t)) + dgamma*lam + dt_phi;
731	            dlam_c  = dbeta*(-dt_t*a_t) + dgamma*dt_t;
732	            dAreal_c= dalpha*(dt_t*a_t) + dbeta*((1.0f-lam)*dt_t*dt_t*a_t);
733	        }
734	        // Reduce the 3 head scalars over the channels of each head. Loop heads;
735	        // each head's lanes [h*head_dim, (h+1)*head_dim) contribute, owner = first lane.
736	        #pragma unroll
737	        for (int hh = 0; hh < mb::kNHeads; ++hh) {
738	            const bool mine = active && (h == hh);
739	            float sddt   = mb_block_sum(mine ? ddt_c   : 0.0f, red);
740	            float sdlam  = mb_block_sum(mine ? dlam_c  : 0.0f, red);
741	            float sdAr   = mb_block_sum(mine ? dAreal_c: 0.0f, red);
742	            if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
743	                // A_arg = A_mod + exp(A_log); A_real = -softplus(A_arg)
744	                // (read A_mod/dt_pre/u_lam at any lane — use the cached per-(t,h) values).
745	                const float dt_pre_h = a->dt_pre[t][hh];
746	                const float u_lam_h  = a->u_lam[t][hh];
747	                const float A_arg_h  = a->A_mod[t][hh] + __expf(A_log[hh]);
748	                ddt_pre[t * mb::kNHeads + hh] = sddt * mb_softplus_grad(dt_pre_h);
749	                du_lam [t * mb::kNHeads + hh] = sdlam * mb_sigmoid_grad(u_lam_h);
750	                dA_mod [t * mb::kNHeads + hh] = sdAr * (-mb_softplus_grad(A_arg_h));
751	            }
752	            __syncthreads();
753	        }
754	        // dA_log[h] += sum_t dA_real[t,h]*(-sigmoid(A_arg))*exp(A_log[h]). Fold the
755	        // per-channel dAreal here (same channel-in-head contribution).
756	        if (active) {
757	            const float A_arg = a->A_mod[t][h] + base_rate;
758	            dAlog_acc += dAreal_c * (-mb_sigmoid(A_arg)) * base_rate;
759	        }
760	    }
761	    // reduce dA_log over the head's channels (owner writes the per-head partial).
762	    #pragma unroll
763	    for (int hh = 0; hh < mb::kNHeads; ++hh) {
764	        const bool mine = active && (h == hh);
765	        float sAl = mb_block_sum(mine ? dAlog_acc : 0.0f, red);
766	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) g_A_log[hh] += sAl;
767	        __syncthreads();
768	    }

### Selective scan forward (`mb_scan_fwd`, mamba3.cuh:521-568) — Eq 25
One thread owns SSM channel `j∈[0,d_inner)`; its head `h=j/head_dim`. Per-coord complex
state `h[Nc][2]` + prev v_t held in **per-thread REGISTERS** (the seq=8 exploit), t-loop
rolled 0..7. Recurrence:
- `alpha=exp(dt*A); gamma=lam*dt; beta=(1-lam)*dt*alpha; phi=dt*theta`.
- `v_t=(Br2*x,Bi2*x); h_t=alpha*R h_{t-1}+beta*R v_{t-1}+gamma*v_t; y_t=Σ_c Cbar·h_t`.
- `R(phi)@(w0,w1)=(cos*w0-sin*w1, sin*w0+cos*w1)` via `__sincosf`.

CRITICAL impl note (mamba3.cuh:527-531): the per-coord arrays `hr/hi/vpr/vpi[kStateC]`
are **runtime-indexed local memory**; the c-loop is intentionally NOT `#pragma unroll`'d
(full unroll forces >255 regs and the carried state across the t-loop would not persist —
the documented "t=0 right, t>0 wrong" bug). t-loop (seq=8) stays rolled.

### Selective scan backward (`mb_scan_bwd`, mamba3.cuh:596-770) — reverse time
RECOMPUTES the forward keeping `hh[kSeq+1][kStateC]` + `vh[kSeq][kStateC]` (complex) in
registers (seq=8 → NO checkpoint), then reverse-scans the WIDTH-2 two-adjoint (gh,gv)
recurrence (v_{t-1} feeds step t-1's gamma AND step t's beta).
- Per-(t,c): updates gh += Cbar·dy, dCbar = h·dy; v-grad `dv=gv+gamma*gh` → dx, dBbar;
  rotated-term coeff grads dalpha/dbeta/dgamma; dphi via `R'(phi)`; propagate via R^T
  (mamba3.cuh:693-698: `RTg0=cs*g0+sn*g1, RTg1=-sn*g0+cs*g1; gv=b_t*RTg, gh=a_t*RTg`).
- Coefficient Jacobian fold (sec 6.3, mamba3.cuh:720-732): ddt, dlam, dA_real folded;
  then `ddt_pre=ddt*softplus'(dt_pre)`, `dA_mod=dA_real*(-sigmoid(A_arg))`,
  `du_lam=dlam*sigmoid'(u_lam)`, dA_log fold `dAreal*(-sigmoid(A_arg))*exp(A_log)`.

DETERMINISM of the scan bwd (mamba3.cuh:591-594, 700-768): head-shared dBbar/dCbar/dtheta
are block-reduced per (t,c) over ALL channels (ascending lane/warp); per-head coeff grads
block-reduced per (t,h) via a masked `mb_block_sum` looped over heads (owner = thread 0
writes). Same addends in fixed order → A/A/A bit-identical by construction.

NOTE the `active = threadIdx.x < kDInner` guard (mamba3.cuh:608): with 256 threads and
kDInner=256 at d=128, every thread is active; at OTHER widths inactive threads still
participate in the block reduces (contributing 0) so the reduce shape is uniform.

### Other device primitives (all CTA-cooperative, mamba3.cuh)
- `mb_block_sum`/`mb_block_max` (319-356): warp-shuffle + 8-warp two-level reduce via
  `red[64]` (8 warp slots used; 64-slot field).
- `mb_linear` (361-376): y=x@Wᵀ(+b), thread per (s,o).

## 3. The persistent megakernel structure (fused_mamba_megakernel.cuh)

Two kernels in this file, gated:
- SCALAR (legacy fp32): `fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>` + `launch_fused_mamba_megakernel`,
  gated by `SG_MB_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL` (default 1). Lines 185-353.
- TC (production): `fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<Opt>` + 2 launchers, gated by the wgmma
  token `SG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL==SG_GEMM_IMPL_WGMMA`. Lines 362-1278.

### SG_MB_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL gate (megakernel.cuh:109-127)
The scalar kernel's `MambaSampleSmem` GROWS with SG_MB_D; at bench width d=1024 it is
≈1.1 MB, far over the ~228 KB/SM budget, so `cudaFuncSetAttribute(MaxDynamicSharedMemory)`
would REFUSE it. Gating it OFF (`-DSG_MB_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL=0`) lets the whole extension
compile at bench width (only the TC path is measured there). DEFAULT 1 → d=128 production
build byte-for-byte unchanged.

### 5-phase / 3-barrier layout (identical to the decoder; megakernel.cuh:20-37)
- **P0** each CTA zeroes its FULL grad partial slice + loss slot. — B0 —
- **P1** BATCH-PARALLEL fwd+bwd: each CTA owns a FIXED contiguous batch slice (by
  blockIdx.x), processes samples ONE AT A TIME (CTA-cooperative), broadcasting kSeq tokens
  + target into smem, running `mb_forward_sample`+`mb_backward_sample`, accumulating each
  sample's grad into the CTA's partial (single-owner-per-element, NO atomics →
  deterministic), summing fp32 NLL. — B1 —
- **P2** DETERMINISTIC cross-CTA reduce: sum `partial[0..nCTA)` in ASCENDING CTA index
  into global grad (no float atomics; order fixed → reuses the work-steal queue to pick
  WHO reduces which tensor). Loss: fp64 ordered sum → loss/B by CTA 0. — B2 (sync_reset,
  also resets the queue for P3) —
- **P3** the REAL `apply_optimizer<Opt>` tail over the reduced grad (work-steal the 45
  tensors; the code comment says "28"/"45" inconsistently — see §6).

### NO warp-group register repartition (megakernel.cuh:68-71, 210-218)
UNLIKE the decoder/vit seams, the Mamba kernel does NOT do the producer/consumer
`setmaxnreg` (dealloc<32>/alloc<200>). ALL 256 threads do SYMMETRIC selective-scan work,
each owning a channel and holding large register-resident scan state (fwd A[16]+h[16];
bwd adds hh[kSeq+1][kState]+a_save+dB/dC_loc+gh+dA), so a dealloc<32> would spill it.
`__launch_bounds__(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK)` sets the uniform budget; the compiler allocates
symmetrically across all 256 threads.

### TC kernel min-blocks-per-SM / determinism (megakernel.cuh:370-388)
`SG_MBTC_MIN_BLOCKS_PER_SM` DEFAULT 1 = register-maximal (255 reg/thread → occ=1),
one-CTA-per-SM, which the GridBarrier is DESIGNED for ("occupancy=1 IS the design point").
Setting 2 caps regs to ~128 so two CTAs co-reside (MEASURED 1.14× faster, B=16384
113→99ms) **BUT IS DETERMINISM-UNSAFE**: the A/A/A gate proves occ=2 grads are NOT
bit-identical (max|Δ|=2.3e-10, timing-dependent) while occ=1 IS exactly bit-identical —
the hand-built grid barrier's two-fence visibility model assumes one CTA/SM; co-residency
exposes a P1-partial→P2-reduce visibility race. The substrate fix lives in
megakernel_common.cuh (not this lane); until it lands, occ=1 is mandatory.

### TC kernel optimizer staging (P2.x phases, megakernel.cuh:665-1203)
The TC kernel composes the full optimizer-stage zoo (PORTed from the decoder/vit twins),
each `if constexpr (Opt==...)`-gated so every other cell is byte-identical:
- **P2.4** (LookSAM / SuperGrok11/15/2): the MODEL-COUPLED SAM 2nd backward producing
  `st.sam_dir = g_sam − g` (LookSAM) or `st.sharpness = (g_sam−g)²` (SG11/15/2).
  Mechanism (megakernel.cuh:712-822): global ‖g‖ via deterministic ascending-CTA reduce
  → rho_over_norm → backup+perturb p in place (`params[i]+=rho/‖g‖·grad[i]`, save backup
